summary: Machine-readable execution board for the 72 site. For agents, not people. Each page also embeds its own scoped spec at <script type="application/json" id="agent-spec">. Statuses: pending (do it now) | blocked (needs an input first) | done. Priority: high | med | low.

conventions.membership: Every user is a member. First month free, then $7.20/month. Product is in beta.
conventions.branch: Develop on a feature branch, never main.
conventions.secrets_rule: Never commit sk_live_*/sk_test_*. Worker secrets via `wrangler secret put`. pk_* and Buy-Button IDs are safe to commit.
conventions.reuse_first: Scan boneyard/index.json before hand-building any UI.
conventions.twilio_rule: Provision phone numbers in the 772 area code ONLY (on-brand with '72'). Any number search/purchase must filter areaCode=772.

pages.title: Home / launchpad
pages.purpose: Landing: who-it's-for + hub of buttons to every page

pages.title: Legacy landing (redirect)
pages.purpose: Redirect shim to /index.html; kept so old dashboard/invite links resolve

actions.title: Flip paygate Buy Button from test to live
actions.do: Replace the test buy-button-id and pk_test_* publishable-key with the LIVE Buy-Button ID and pk_live_* key (remade in Stripe Live mode).
actions.verify: Load paygate.html; Buy Button renders in live mode; a real card is charged.

actions.title: Flip landing Payment Link from test to live
actions.do: Replace STRIPE_PAYMENT_LINK with the live buy.stripe.com link (first month free, then $7.20/mo). Mirror the same value into 72-landing-merged.html and 72-landing-opal.html.
actions.verify: Signup flow opens the live checkout and charges after the free month.

actions.title: Set the Worker's live Stripe secret
actions.do: Run `wrangler secret put STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` with the sk_live_* key. Never commit it.
actions.verify: Worker completes a live Stripe checkout session.

actions.title: Wire the 10-call toll pack button
actions.do: Replace the toll-pack 'Coming soon' placeholder anchor with the live $7.20 10-call-pack Stripe link once phone numbers/routing are on.
actions.verify: Toll-pack button opens checkout for the 10-call pack.

actions.title: Replace illustrative QR with the real per-member QR
actions.do: The QR SVG in the .qr-card frame is illustrative only. Swap for the member's real generated QR (from qr.html / member dashboard) that deep-links to their pay-then-room flow.
actions.verify: Scanning the QR opens checkout and lands in the member's Jitsi room.

actions.title: Consolidate the duplicate landing
actions.do: DONE: 72-landing-merged.html was a byte-copy of index.html that drifted. Collapsed into a redirect shim to /index.html (preserves query string + hash), so the dashboard 'Your page' link and owner invite links still resolve without editing the dashboards. index.html is now the single landing source.
actions.verify: 72-landing-merged.html redirects to /index.html; no second full copy of the landing remains.

actions.title: Have privacy + terms reviewed
actions.do: Both documents are general templates, not legal advice. Have a qualified attorney review before relying on them.
